verdict.rationale: Jev documents an official Claude Code/Codex agent skill installable via 'claude plugin marketplace add typesafe-ai/skills' that gives coding agents context on the API, plus official Python/JS SDKs and a dedicated coding-agents doc, and a third-party curated ecosystem list tags integrations by agent (Pi, Claude Code, Codex). missing for 10: no independent hands-on verification of the skill/plugin working in practice, and no evidence of first-class integrations beyond Claude/Codex (e.g., other major agent frameworks like LangChain/AutoGPT).
